thread:
pat_oncall: quick proposal: introduce a two-lane remediation model (fastlane/slowlane) to reduce long-tail action items

ivy_sre: curious. how do lanes differ operationally?

pat_oncall: fastlane = triage + mitigation within 72h, full remediation within 14d. slowlane = triage within 7d, remediation within 45d. owners pick based on severity and impact

mina_pm: nice. can we require a one-line "owner smoke check" step before any close? prevents false-done marks

kai_dev: add a tiny ticket template so owners don't guess. something like:
```
owner: @<user>
lane: fast|slow
due_triage: YYYY-MM-DD
due_remediate: YYYY-MM-DD
mitigation: short
smoke_check: steps
recurrence_flag: yes/no
handoff_tape: list of context links
tags: remediation/tapecheck
```

pat_oncall: exactly. also propose a "stale-ticker" metric and weekly "tapecheck" digest posted to #eng-oncall every Mon 09:00 by ops-bot

ops-bot: automated: will post weekly tapecheck digest Mon 09:00 with items in remediation/tapecheck and flag overdue ones

ivy_sre: on comms cadence: require 1-line updates in the incident thread every 72h until remediation closed. if cross-team, owner must ping reviewers in the update

mina_pm: roles: owner = coordinates and runs initial smoke, reviewers = validate change and sign-off. oncall lead becomes scoreboard owner if remediation misses lane deadline

kai_dev: for IC rotation: propose 1-week shadow + 1-week lead (2-week cycle). rotation owner facilitates weekly tapecheck sync while on lead week

pat_oncall: good. also add an automatic recurrence detector: if service appears on tapecheck >3 times in 60d, ops-bot will tag product and eng-sre and create a "pattern" issue

ivy_sre: tiny enforcement: ops-bot will prevent closing a remediation ticket if smoke_check is empty or reviewers not listed

mina_pm: we should measure pilot success: target 40% reduction in Stage B overdue in 6 weeks and fewer repeat services on the pattern list

kai_dev: slash prototype idea: `/remediate quick --lane=fast --owner=@kai_dev --title="redis failover cleanup"` fills the template and tags tapecheck

pat_oncall: I'll draft updated oncall README with lane rubric and the ticket body template. can someone own wiring ops-bot digest?

ivy_sre: I'll own ops-bot config and recurrence detector for the pilot window

mina_pm: I'll run the pilot coordination and collect metrics. propose a 6-week pilot then a 30-min retro

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: pilot kickoff note will post to #eng-oncall Mon 09:00. weekly tapecheck digest enabled

kai_dev: one pragmatic rule: infra-affecting remediations require an explicit rollback plan and a canary window in ticket body

pat_oncall: agreed. last piece: if owner misses fastlane triage, auto-assign temp owner = oncall lead for 48h to get momentum, then revert

ivy_sre: love the momentum trick. reduces orphaned actions

mina_pm: ok next steps: pat update README + template, ivy wire ops-bot, kai prototype slash, i'll schedule pilot kickoff and retro

pat_oncall: i'll create the tracking ticket now and post link here when ready

kai_dev: :thumbsup: excited to try the lanes and tapecheck cadence
